title: EA Skills reference taxonomy
description: One reference architecture or industry blueprint, as a taxonomy of nodes the local model is measured against. Hash-pinned: the tooling refuses to read a pack whose SHA256SUMS do not match (ALN001).

name.description: Human name of the reference model, e.g. 'NIST CSF 2.0'.

version.description: The edition this pack transcribes; part of what the NOTICE cites.

source.description: Where the taxonomy came from. Licence terms live in NOTICE.md.

kind.description: What the node is; `align` reads local elements per kind.

parent.description: Id of the node this one decomposes. The only relation a taxonomy has: out-of-scope decisions inherit down it, coverage claims do not.

externalId.description: The code the source publishes, e.g. 'GV.OC'. Printed in reports.
